sf2.items.register_weapon.returns: An item handle with the weapon category.
sf2.items.register_weapon.summary: Create a new weapon definition owned by your mod.
sf2.items.register_weapon.when: Entrypoint, before listing or referencing this item.

sf2.items.register_armor.returns: An item handle with the armor category.
sf2.items.register_armor.summary: Create a new armor definition owned by your mod.
sf2.items.register_armor.when: Entrypoint, before listing or referencing this item.

sf2.items.register_helm.returns: An item handle with the helm category.
sf2.items.register_helm.summary: Create a new helm definition owned by your mod.
sf2.items.register_helm.when: Entrypoint, before listing or referencing this item.

sf2.items.register_ranged.returns: An item handle with the ranged category.
sf2.items.register_ranged.summary: Create a new ranged definition owned by your mod.
sf2.items.register_ranged.when: Entrypoint, before listing or referencing this item.

sf2.items.register_magic.returns: An item handle with the magic category.
sf2.items.register_magic.summary: Create a new magic definition owned by your mod.
sf2.items.register_magic.when: Entrypoint, before listing or referencing this item.

sf2.items.register_consumable.returns: An item handle for this non-equipment category.
sf2.items.register_consumable.summary: Create a consumable, such as a mod-owned entry ticket for a mode.

sf2.items.register_free.returns: An item handle for this non-equipment category.
sf2.items.register_free.summary: Create a free-category item for content and reward definitions.

sf2.items.register_seal.returns: An item handle for this non-equipment category.
sf2.items.register_seal.summary: Create a seal-category item for content and reward definitions.

sf2.items.get.returns: An item handle. Missing IDs or references outside allowed ownership raise errors; this function does not return `nil` for a missing item.
sf2.items.get.summary: Obtain a handle to an existing item definition, including a core item.
sf2.items.get.requires: `content.register`; other owners must be declared dependencies.
sf2.items.get.when: Entrypoint, before using the handle in another definition.

sf2.items.alias.summary: Let an old saved item ID resolve to a current item definition.
sf2.items.alias.when: Entrypoint, after registering the replacement item.

sf2.items.tombstone.summary: Reserve an old item ID when it has been retired without a replacement.

sf2.shop.addItem.returns: The listing's qualified ID as a string.
sf2.shop.addItem.summary: Add a shop listing for equipment owned by your mod.

sf2.shop.set_availability.summary: Apply a non-economic visibility policy to an existing item.
sf2.shop.set_availability.requires: `content.patch`; a declared dependency when targeting another owner. Obtaining an item handle with `sf2.items.get` also requires `content.register`.
sf2.shop.set_availability.when: Entrypoint, after obtaining the item handle.

sf2.price.coins.summary: Create a coin price to use in a shop listing. This does not spend or grant coins.
sf2.price.coins.requires: No capability to construct the price; listing it requires `content.register`.

sf2.price.gems.returns: An opaque price handle. The same integer bounds as coin prices apply.
sf2.price.gems.summary: Create a gem price to use in a shop listing.
sf2.price.gems.requires: No capability to construct the price.

sf2.assets.sprite.returns: A sprite handle. Missing assets and assets of another type raise errors.
sf2.assets.sprite.summary: Get a sprite handle for an item icon, achievement, or location image.
sf2.assets.sprite.requires: No capability; cross-mod references require a dependency.
sf2.assets.sprite.when: Usually during registration, before passing the handle to a definition.

sf2.assets.model.returns: A model handle. The asset must exist and be classified as a model.
sf2.assets.model.summary: Get a model handle for equipment.
sf2.assets.model.requires: No capability; cross-mod references require a dependency.

sf2.assets.audio.returns: An audio handle. Missing or non-audio assets raise an error.
sf2.assets.audio.summary: Get an audio handle for location music or a move's sound action.
sf2.assets.audio.requires: No capability; cross-mod references require a dependency.
sf2.assets.audio.when: During registration before using the handle.

sf2.assets.binary.returns: A binary handle. An asset of another kind is rejected.
sf2.assets.binary.summary: Get a binary asset handle for an animation supplied to `sf2.moves.register`.
sf2.assets.binary.requires: No capability; cross-mod references require a dependency.

sf2.assets.qualify.returns: A normalized string. It does not check whether the asset exists.
sf2.assets.qualify.summary: Turn a local asset path into its complete namespaced ID. This is useful in logs.
sf2.assets.qualify.requires: No capability. Cross-mod references require a declared dependency.

sf2.assets.exists.returns: `true` if the asset is described by the resolver, otherwise `false`. It does not guarantee successful image decoding or that the asset has the type you want. Malformed or unauthorized references raise an error.
sf2.assets.exists.summary: Check whether an asset ID is available before choosing it.
sf2.assets.exists.requires: No capability; the referenced owner must be your mod or a dependency.

sf2.assets.replace.summary: Redirect a supported asset ID to another asset owned by your mod.
sf2.assets.replace.requires: `assets.replace` and a declared dependency on the target's owner.
sf2.assets.replace.when: Entrypoint. Restart after enabling/disabling a replacement mod.

sf2.localization.key.returns: A localization handle. Missing keys raise an error.
sf2.localization.key.summary: Get the typed localization handle used by item names, perks, and achievements.
sf2.localization.key.requires: `content.register`; other owners must be declared dependencies.
sf2.localization.key.when: Entrypoint, after the key has been registered by Lua or discovered from localization files.

sf2.localization.text.returns: A plain translated string. Resolution uses the requested language, then `eng`, then an empty string if neither exists. Invalid handles or language values raise an error.
sf2.localization.text.requires: A localization handle created by this script context; no additional capability for reading. Creating the handle requires `content.register` and the usual dependency declaration when referencing another owner.
sf2.localization.text.when: Entrypoint or later callbacks. Obtain the handle with `key` during registration and retain it for later reads. Each call reads current content, including committed localization patches; it does not freeze a translation at registration time. A patch made in the current transaction is also readable before commit.

sf2.localization.register.returns: A localization handle for the registered key.
sf2.localization.register.summary: Register one translation owned by your mod and get its localization handle.

sf2.localization.patch.summary: Replace one language value of an existing localization definition.
sf2.localization.patch.requires: `content.patch`, plus a dependency on the target's owner.

sf2.state.register.summary: Define the names, types, initial values, and version of your saved data.
sf2.state.register.when: Entrypoint, once for the mod's schema.

sf2.state.get.returns: A number, integer-valued number, boolean, or string; `nil` if no value is present for that name. Invalid names or unavailable state raise errors.
sf2.state.get.summary: Read one value belonging to this mod.
sf2.state.get.requires: `state.read` and a registered, successfully loaded schema.
sf2.state.get.when: A supported callback after profile load.

sf2.state.set.summary: Update one or more fields together. Unmentioned fields retain their values.
sf2.state.set.when: A supported callback after profile load.

sf2.state.unset.summary: Remove a field's explicit value and apply its schema's default, if it has one.
sf2.state.unset.when: A supported callback after profile load.

sf2.random.integer.summary: Draw a whole number with equal probability for each value in an inclusive range.
sf2.random.integer.requires: `state.read` and `state.write`; an owned, declared integer state field.
sf2.random.integer.when: After profile state is bound, in a supported callback.

sf2.random.number.summary: Draw a fractional value from zero inclusive to one exclusive.
sf2.random.number.requires: `state.read` and `state.write`; an owned, declared integer state field.
sf2.random.number.when: After profile state is bound, in a supported callback.

sf2.behaviors.register.summary: Register a behavior with one or more supported combat callbacks.
sf2.behaviors.register.requires: `content.register`. Operations performed by callbacks may require additional capabilities such as `combat.magic_charge`.
sf2.behaviors.register.when: Entrypoint, before registering perks, enchantments, or rules that use it.

sf2.perks.get.returns: A perk handle. Missing or inaccessible definitions raise errors.
sf2.perks.get.summary: Look up an existing perk definition.
sf2.perks.get.requires: `content.register`; a dependency on another owner when applicable.

sf2.perks.register.returns: A perk handle. Registration does not automatically teach it to the player.
sf2.perks.register.summary: Register a new perk backed by your own Lua behavior.
sf2.perks.register.requires: `content.register`, plus the capabilities used by its behavior.
sf2.perks.register.when: Entrypoint, after the behavior it uses is available.

sf2.enchantments.register.returns: An enchantment handle. The player still needs to forge and equip it.
sf2.enchantments.register.summary: Create a forgeable enchantment for selected equipment categories.
sf2.enchantments.register.requires: `content.register`, plus the capabilities used by its behavior.

sf2.zones.register.summary: Create a map page for your battles.

sf2.zones.get.returns: A zone handle; a missing or inaccessible ID raises an error.
sf2.zones.get.summary: Obtain an existing zone's handle instead of creating a new page.
sf2.zones.get.requires: `content.register` and a dependency on an external owner.

sf2.battles.register.summary: Create the map entry that the player selects to open a fight.

sf2.battles.set_locked.returns: `true` when applied or already in the requested state. `false` when the profile/map is unavailable, native input is blocked, a transition or encounter preparation is pending, or the battle has no saved revealed entry.
sf2.battles.set_locked.summary: Change the saved lock of a revealed battle owned by this mod.
sf2.battles.set_locked.requires: `story.progression`, this script's own battle handle and a boolean `locked`. Strings, forged handles, core battles and other mods' battles are not accepted. Register entries first, then reveal them before changing locks.
sf2.battles.set_locked.when: On an initialized map, such as a normal UI `on_click` callback after story presentation. Calls during UI `on_close` cleanup raise an error; cleanup may run because the scene/profile is being replaced. Do not retry in a tight loop.

sf2.battles.reveal.returns: `true` when the entry exists or was created; `false` when the profile, map or native battle is unavailable, input is blocked, or a transition, encounter preparation or settlement prevents progression.
sf2.battles.reveal.summary: Create the saved map entry for a battle owned by this mod, then refresh the map.
sf2.battles.reveal.requires: `story.progression`, this script's own registered battle handle, and a strict boolean `locked`. Strings, foreign/core handles and forged handles are rejected. Register the battle's fights during loading.
sf2.battles.reveal.when: On an initialized map, usually from an ordinary UI `on_click` after story presentation. UI `on_close` cleanup calls raise an error. Do not retry in a tight loop. Several reveals may be followed by a focus in the same callback.

sf2.battles.focus.returns: `true` when focus is applied; `false` when the entry is absent, hidden, outside the current map mode, or blocked by the same lifecycle/input guards as reveal.
sf2.battles.focus.summary: Select an owned battle already represented on the current map.
sf2.battles.focus.requires: `story.progression` and this script's own battle handle.
sf2.battles.focus.when: On an initialized map, including after reveal in the same UI callback. Calls from UI `on_close` cleanup raise an error.

sf2.warriors.get_template.returns: A warrior-template handle; missing IDs raise errors.
sf2.warriors.get_template.summary: Get an existing opponent template as the starting point for a new warrior.

sf2.warriors.register.summary: Define an opponent, optionally inheriting from a core template.

sf2.rewards.register.summary: Create a reward that a fight can grant through its normal result/save flow.
sf2.rewards.register.when: Entrypoint, before the fight uses the reward.

sf2.fights.register.summary: Connect a battle to opponents, rounds, rules, and rewards.

sf2.fights.patch.summary: Replace supported fields on an existing registered fight.
sf2.fights.patch.requires: `content.patch`, and a dependency on the target owner.
sf2.fights.patch.when: Entrypoint, after the target mod has committed its definitions.

sf2.rules.no_perks.summary: Disable perks matching the rule's target and optional name filter.
sf2.rules.no_perks.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight.

sf2.rules.require_item.summary: Require an item as a fight-entry/equipment condition.
sf2.rules.require_item.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight.

sf2.rules.equip_item.summary: Apply a specified item to the target for this fight.
sf2.rules.equip_item.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight.

sf2.rules.avatar.summary: Override the target's fight portrait reference.
sf2.rules.avatar.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight.

sf2.rules.name.summary: Override the target's displayed name during the fight.
sf2.rules.name.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight.

sf2.rules.no_button.summary: Disable a named combat button through the native fight-rule system.
sf2.rules.no_button.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight.

sf2.rules.perk.summary: Apply a perk rule to the selected target.
sf2.rules.perk.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight.

sf2.rules.behavior.returns: A rule handle; put it in `sf2.fights.register { rules = { rule } }`.
sf2.rules.behavior.summary: Attach executable Lua behavior directly to a fight, without creating a perk or requiring an equipped item.
sf2.rules.behavior.requires: `content.register`. Each fighter operation still requires its own combat capability, declared by the mod that owns the behavior.
sf2.rules.behavior.when: Register in the entrypoint. Attached handlers run only at the supported combat callback boundaries of the selected fight.

sf2.rules.recharge_magic_each_round.summary: Request normal magic recharge at round boundaries.
sf2.rules.recharge_magic_each_round.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight.

sf2.rules.attributes.summary: Apply a map of native fight attribute values.
sf2.rules.attributes.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight.

sf2.rules.hot_ground.summary: Create the native timed hot-ground rule used by challenge fights.
sf2.rules.hot_ground.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight or encounter plan.

sf2.rules.ring_out.summary: Create a native ring-out boundary rule.
sf2.rules.ring_out.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight or encounter plan.

sf2.rules.regeneration.summary: Create the native regeneration or degeneration rule.
sf2.rules.regeneration.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight or encounter plan.

sf2.rules.remove_interval.summary: Remove one native animation interval class from the selected target.
sf2.rules.remove_interval.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight or encounter plan.

sf2.rules.no_animation.summary: Disable one named native animation for both fighters.
sf2.rules.no_animation.when: Entrypoint, before attaching the rule to a fight or encounter plan.

sf2.quests.register.summary: Create a quest that responds to selected game events.
sf2.quests.register.when: Entrypoint, after the battle/fight/item definitions used by the quest.

sf2.progression.replace_perk_branch.requires: `content.patch`; looking up or registering perks also requires `content.register`.
sf2.progression.replace_perk_branch.when: During mod loading, before the perk tree is used.

sf2.forge.profile.requires: `content.register`, and a declared dependency when reading another mod's content.

sf2.items.set_innate_perks.requires: `content.patch`; item/perk lookup or registration also requires `content.register`. Declare dependencies for referenced core or other-mod content.
sf2.items.set_innate_perks.when: During mod loading, before fighters are built.

sf2.items.set_tactic_subtype.summary: Replace the AI table group of a core or owned weapon without changing its animation subtype.
sf2.items.set_tactic_subtype.requires: `content.patch`; item lookup also requires `content.register`. Declare dependencies for referenced namespaces.
sf2.items.set_tactic_subtype.when: During entrypoint registration. The override applies when content is loaded, before subsequent fights are constructed.

sf2.items.set_subtype.summary: Change the combat family of an existing weapon, ranged item or magic definition. Native animation conditions and projectile selection use this subtype.
sf2.items.set_subtype.requires: `content.patch`; obtaining an item handle also requires `content.register`. Declare a dependency on the item's owner.
sf2.items.set_subtype.when: During mod loading, before profile equipment and fighters are built.

sf2.items.set_default_enchantments.requires: `content.patch`; item/perk lookup or registration also requires `content.register`. Declare dependencies for referenced content from core or other mods.

sf2.forge.override_deviation.requires: `content.patch`, `content.register` for the profile lookup, and a declared `core` dependency.

sf2.forge.exclude_candidate.requires: `content.patch`, `content.register` for handle lookups, and a declared `core` dependency.

sf2.locales.register.returns: The qualified locale ID as a string.

sf2.profile.perk.returns: A fresh table with `learned` (boolean) and `upgrade` (integer when learned; `nil` otherwise). Upgrade zero is a valid stored value; it does not mean unlearned. The number is the native `UpgradeLevel`, not a count of purchases.
sf2.profile.perk.summary: Read whether the active profile has learned a perk and its stored upgrade number. This queries the learned-perk list, not temporary combat effects, equipment enchantments or whether a trigger is currently active.
sf2.profile.perk.requires: `profile.read`. Pass a perk handle acquired in the same script context, or a qualified perk ID string. Other namespaces, including `core`, require a declared dependency. Strings need no `content.register` capability. Malformed IDs, wrong categories, unavailable definitions, forged handles and queries without an active profile raise errors.
sf2.profile.perk.when: After the active game profile has loaded, for example in a UI or story callback. A profile switch or perk upgrade is reflected on the next query.

sf2.profile.level.returns: The active player's level as an integer.
sf2.profile.level.when: After a game profile has loaded.

sf2.profile.item.returns: A new snapshot table with these fields:
sf2.profile.item.requires: `profile.read` and either an item handle obtained by this mod context or a qualified item ID string. Other namespaces, including `core`, require a declared dependency. String queries do not require `content.register`.
sf2.profile.item.when: After a game profile has loaded.

sf2.profile.fight.returns: A fresh table with `present` (boolean), `wins` (integer) and `losses` (integer). A known fight with no saved record returns `false`, `0`, `0`.
sf2.profile.fight.summary: Read saved progress for a fight without creating or changing its save record.
sf2.profile.fight.requires: `profile.read`. Pass a qualified fight ID string or a fight handle created in this script context. Other namespaces, including `core`, require a declared dependency. String queries do not require `content.register`.
sf2.profile.fight.when: After a profile loads, for example inside a `battle_result` callback. The host must have an active content catalog. An unavailable profile or unknown fight raises an error; it is not reported as an unwon fight.

sf2.profile.set_eclipse_mode.returns: A boolean: `true` if the requested mode is active and the story map is ready after the request (including when already in that mode). `false` if the map is unavailable, blocked, not in story mode, the native switch is absent, or its quest has not finished. A false result can follow a partial native transition; retry from a later user action instead of assuming the mode is unchanged.
sf2.profile.set_eclipse_mode.summary: Request the existing Eclipse switch on the story map, including its native button, map tint, replay battles and tutorial behavior.
sf2.profile.set_eclipse_mode.requires: `story.progression`. `enabled` must be a boolean. Missing capability, wrong argument types or an unavailable host service raise errors.
sf2.profile.set_eclipse_mode.when: From a user or story callback with an active profile on the ready map. Do not call from `on_close` cleanup, which rejects progression changes.

sf2.story.on.requires: `story.events`, an event name (`purchase`, `enchantment`, `level_up`, `scene_enter`, `item_acquired` or `battle_result`) and a Lua function.
sf2.story.on.when: During mod loading or a callback while the script is active, including before a profile loads.

sf2.story.off.requires: `story.events` and a handle created by this script context. Copied, fabricated or foreign handles are rejected.
sf2.story.off.when: While the script is active, including inside the subscription's callback.

sf2.story.is_active.returns: `true` while subscribed; `false` after cancellation or callback failure. An active subscription can be waiting for a profile to load.
sf2.story.is_active.requires: `story.events` and this script context's subscription handle.

sf2.scenes.open.returns: `true` if the native transition accepted the request or that scene is already current. `false` if navigation is currently unavailable or a native quest/tab gate consumed the request. A `true` result is not loading completion; observe `scene_enter` with [story subscriptions](../story/) for destination entry.
sf2.scenes.open.requires: `presentation.navigate`. `destination` is exactly one of `map`, `shop`, `profile` or `dojo`. Other values raise an error. Calling without a host navigation service also raises an error. Opening UI separately requires `ui.create`.
sf2.scenes.open.when: After a profile and a menu scene have initialized. Intended for custom menu buttons. Navigation is rejected while a transition is underway, encounter preparation is pending, native input is blocked, a lock screen is active, or the source is a fight, loader, preloader or credits scene. Navigation during a UI `on_close` callback raises an error: cleanup must not initiate another transition.

sf2.locations.name.returns: The location's qualified ID as a string.
sf2.locations.name.requires: A valid location handle belonging to the current scripting context; no additional capability.
sf2.locations.name.when: During mod loading, after obtaining the location handle.

sf2.locations.select_dojo.requires: `presentation.dojo` and this mod's registered location handle with `dojo = true`. UI creation separately requires `ui.create`.
sf2.locations.select_dojo.when: After a game profile has loaded, normally from a selector's UI callback. The new backdrop applies on the next dojo entry; it does not refresh an open dojo.

sf2.locations.reset_dojo.requires: `presentation.dojo`. The saved choice must belong to this mod or already be empty; another mod's preference cannot be cleared by this function.
sf2.locations.reset_dojo.when: After a game profile has loaded, normally from a reset button.

sf2.locations.selected_dojo.returns: Saved qualified location ID string, or `nil` for the native default.
sf2.locations.selected_dojo.when: After a game profile has loaded.

sf2.moves.register_template.when: During mod loading, before moves that use the template.

sf2.moves.register.requires: `content.register`, plus dependencies for external templates or assets.

sf2.moves.extend_item_lock.when: During registration. Applied to already-loaded native moves before external moves and fighters are built. Requires Apply & Restart when changing enabled content; it does not rebuild already-created fighter snapshots in place.

sf2.moves.patch.requires: `content.patch` and any dependencies required by referenced conditions.
sf2.moves.patch.when: Entrypoint. Registration records the patch; native application validates its target after base animations are available, before a fight starts.

sf2.moves.remove_perk_lock.summary: Remove one exact direct perk lock from an existing native move.
sf2.moves.remove_perk_lock.requires: `content.patch`, plus access to the referenced perk through core or a declared dependency.
sf2.moves.remove_perk_lock.when: During mod registration. The patch is applied when the active content set is projected into the recovered move runtime and is restored when that overlay is removed or rolled back.

sf2.tactics.register.when: During mod loading, before warriors that use it.

sf2.tactics.name.returns: The tactic's qualified ID as a string.
sf2.tactics.name.requires: A valid tactic handle from the current scripting context; no additional capability.
sf2.tactics.name.when: During mod loading, after obtaining the tactic handle.

sf2.modes.register.summary: Create a progression sequence, such as a repeatable trial.

sf2.events.register.summary: Create a scheduled or permanently available event using the sequence format.

sf2.raids.register.summary: Register a local offline raid sequence.
sf2.raids.register.when: Entrypoint, after its fights with battle type `"raid"`.

sf2.modes.resolve.requires: The pending request supplied to this script's `on_prepare`. Forged or foreign request tables are rejected. No extra capability.
sf2.modes.resolve.when: Complete a pending preparation, including from a UI callback. Reusing a resolved/canceled request or supplying an invalid plan is an error. It marks the request ready; native validation/save/entry occur after Lua returns.

sf2.modes.cancel.requires: An owned request. No extra capability.
sf2.modes.cancel.when: Cancel an unfinished setup, for example in the view's `on_close`. No ticket is charged and no fight starts. Repeated cancellation is harmless. Cancellation after resolution is a no-op, so closing a successful choice view cannot undo the selected plan. Scene/script teardown can still prevent launch.

sf2.modes.is_pending.requires: An owned request. No extra capability.
sf2.modes.is_pending.when: Guard buttons or late callbacks against stale requests.

sf2.timers.set.summary: Set the delivery duration and early-skip policy for new forge orders, optionally making already-paid pending orders eligible for immediate normal completion.

sf2.services.disable.summary: Disable a supported optional service feature group.

sf2.counters.register.summary: Create a counter owned by this mod.

sf2.counters.get.returns: The current integer value as a Lua number.
sf2.counters.get.when: A supported callback after profile load.

sf2.counters.add.returns: The resulting counter value as a Lua number.
sf2.counters.add.summary: Increase a counter and process achievements whose thresholds it reaches.
sf2.counters.add.when: A supported callback after profile load.

sf2.achievements.register.summary: Define an achievement tied to one of your counters.

sf2.log.debug.summary: Write a detailed diagnostic message tagged with your mod's ID.

sf2.log.info.summary: Record a normal milestone, such as successful content registration.

sf2.log.warn.summary: Record a recoverable problem that may help explain unexpected behavior.

sf2.log.error.summary: Record an error message. Logging alone does not stop execution or undo changes.

sf2.ui.open.returns: An owned view handle, or raises an error if validation/mounting fails.
sf2.ui.open.when: During script execution or callbacks with an available game UI host. Scene changes close the resulting view; create it from the relevant lifecycle callback when it must appear in a particular scene. Opening on every tick is unnecessary: keep a handle and update individual widgets.

sf2.ui.close.requires: A view handle from this script context; no additional capability.
sf2.ui.close.when: When the view is no longer needed, including inside its click handler. Closing an already closed valid handle is harmless. Close removes presentation and input ownership; it does not reset your gameplay variables.

sf2.ui.is_open.requires: A view handle from this script context; no additional capability.
sf2.ui.is_open.when: Before an update when Back, scene exit or a callback error may have closed the view. An invalid or foreign handle raises an error, rather than false.

sf2.ui.set_text.requires: An open owned view and a text/button/toggle ID; no additional capability.
sf2.ui.set_text.when: Update a text, button or toggle label. The string may be empty and is limited to 8192 UTF-16 code units. Updates do not rebuild the layout tree.

sf2.ui.set_sprite.requires: An open UI handle and a sprite handle created by the same script context. The widget must be an `image`. Its size, aspect-preserving rendering, visibility and place in the layout stay unchanged. `ui.create` is required to create the surface; the setter grants no additional asset access.
sf2.ui.set_sprite.when: After opening a surface, including from its click/change callbacks. Use this to switch a character portrait, equipment icon or reward preview without rebuilding the panel.

sf2.ui.set_value.requires: An open owned view and a progress/slider ID; no additional capability. Setters do not invoke `on_change`.
sf2.ui.set_value.when: Change a progress widget's fill or a slider's position to a finite fraction from 0 to 1. Invalid values are rejected before mutation.

sf2.ui.set_checked.summary: The checkmark reflects the authored `checked` value from the initial mount, including unchecked toggles. Programmatic changes update the checkmark immediately.
sf2.ui.set_checked.requires: An open owned view and a toggle ID. No additional capability.
sf2.ui.set_checked.when: Set a toggle's boolean state without triggering `on_change`.

sf2.ui.set_visible.requires: An open owned view and a valid widget ID; no additional capability.
sf2.ui.set_visible.when: Show/hide a widget or subtree using a boolean. Hiding the root releases its foreground input priority; showing it restores its original ordering.

sf2.ui.set_enabled.requires: An open owned view and a valid widget ID; no additional capability.
sf2.ui.set_enabled.when: Enable/disable interaction using a boolean. A disabled ancestor prevents its descendants from activating. Disabling a root does not close its modal backdrop.

sf2.quests.suppress.requires: `content.patch`. The target must already be registered in your mod or an explicitly declared dependency. Declare `core` when targeting base quests.
sf2.quests.suppress.when: During registration, before the mod entrypoint returns. Changes take effect through Apply & Restart, before saved quests resume.

sf2.profile.equipment.summary: Inspect the active profile's equipped records without knowing their item IDs in advance.
sf2.profile.equipment.requires: `profile.read`. No item handles or `content.register` capability. An unavailable profile raises an error. Enumeration includes all native equipped records, including records from other mods. Passing a returned ID to a separate `profile.item` query still requires that namespace's declared dependency.
sf2.profile.equipment.when: After an active game profile has loaded, including UI and story callbacks.
